reason: Close two pre-outcome audit gaps: overlapping leave-one-member folds are diagnostic replicates rather than independent trials, and a two-module claim requires measured-run incremental evidence over temporal ablations rather than non-inferiority alone.

premise_inference.diagnostic_fold_rows: retain all 240 House x route x held-out-member LOO rows
premise_inference.aggregation_before_inference: within each House x route, average the eight held-out-member ordered-minus-control normalized-rank deltas
premise_inference.ordered_vs_block_permute_test: one-sided exact sign test on the 30 route-cluster mean deltas; negative is a FULL win and exact ties are omitted
premise_inference.coherent_vs_incoherent_test: one-sided exact sign test on the 30 route-cluster mean deltas; negative is a FULL win and exact ties are omitted
premise_inference.source_label_null: unchanged 256 deterministic House-shared label permutations; it is a randomization test and does not use the 240 folds as an independent sample size

stage2_incremental_evidence.independent_unit: one completed historical run, exactly 30 paired runs
stage2_incremental_evidence.paired_delta: FULL final localization error minus comparator final localization error for the same House, seed and tie mode
stage2_incremental_evidence.win_loss_tie: win if delta < -1e-12, loss if delta > 1e-12, otherwise tie; ties are omitted from the exact sign test
stage2_incremental_evidence.interpretation: Synthetic member-LOO premise establishes that ordered coherent evidence exists in the frozen simulator family. These run-level rules additionally require M2 to contribute positive measured-data evidence after M1, so a tie with all temporal ablations cannot authorize the two-module claim.

Q_reporting.ordered_pair_rows: report as pairwise U-statistic expansion, never as independent calibration sample size
Q_reporting.physical_nuisance_replicates: eight transport members per House-route-source design point

required_synthetic_regressions: a block-order permutation changes a crafted ordered score while preserving the block-count histogram
a crafted member-switch counterexample distinguishes coherent from incoherent marginalization in the expected direction
global Q is invariant to source, House and route enumeration permutations
forbidden: using 240 overlapping held-out-member folds as independent n for a sign test
claiming M2 measured-data utility when FULL only ties a temporal ablation
changing either correction after premise, native PMFS, truth or localization outcome is read
